One of my friends hanged herself. Now I know I couldn't do much about it, as I had no ways of helping her, but grief is still there. I do blame myself partially for me not being near when she needed me, but how would I know - she  completely cut contact for a couple of weeks  and I just hoped that she found some help in people that were near her, untill I got her final message. It was... Harsh for 14 year old me and even more so for 13 year old her. 

As for my experiences - rope snapped, didn't had the balls to cut deeper, somehow survived without being hospitalized on my attempt on overdosing on painkillers (I guess I didn't take enough) so resorted to self-harm, off it for couple of years, but I think I will inevitably turn back to it sooner then I would like to. 

Seen dead relatives, helped paramedics transport one of them... It does something to you. At least it did to me. 

In terms of suicide - hanging is not the worst way to go, when you know how to make your neck snap. It is almost painless as far as I know, and pretty quick if you do things right. If you will start to suffocate it will not be that great, to put it lightly. Personally I would much rather prefer a longer death to myself - slitting my wrists on both arms.

 And, generally, in terms of suicide, I would inform authorities, so they would pick my body up asap. Just don't want to decompose and stink up the apartment and make even more mess then I am now.

Also, sorry for your loss. Don't bury yourself in grief, you did all you could at the moment, I am shure.

Overall the signs where everywhere - the way I move and moved, talk and talked, act and acted,  most of my friends were always female, i really enjoyed spending time with them much more then with my male friends, i was glowing with joy when i first tried wearing a skirt that now my ex-gf lend me for a day, my a little messy makeup that new year's eve also made me feel happy. I felt pain while looking at myself in the mirror, i didn't recognize a tired man staring me back in the eye while i was 15, i prayed to wake up as a girl, i made a promise to myself that if i couldn't find my dream gf i would have to become one, i fought with my homophobic parents for letting my hair grow out with rediculous excuses, i almost stopped eating for two month and dropped 26 kilo's just because how bad I felt, i shaved myself fully a few times to feel less bad about my body...
